Style.name: temperature_contour
Style.title: Air temperature contours
Style.abstract: Bilinear shaded air temperature with contour lines every 2 degrees

Style.name: temperature_contour_smooth
Style.title: Air temperature contours (smoothed)
Style.abstract: Same as temperature_contour, with a SmoothingFilter applied to reduce grid-scale noise before tracing contour lines

Style.name: temperature_contour_dashed
Style.title: Dashed contour lines
Style.abstract: Dashed contour lines on a transparent background, no fill - same pattern as the production pressure_cwk style

Style.name: temperature_shaded
Style.title: Air temperature classes
Style.abstract: Air temperature shaded in fixed 4-degree classes from -52 to 48, using a wide-range multicolor palette

Style.name: temperature_shaded_contour
Style.title: Air temperature classes with contour lines
Style.abstract: Same classed palette as temperature_shaded, with a SmoothingFilter of 4 and blue contour lines every 2 degrees overlaid

Style.name: temperature_shaded_extrasmooth
Style.title: Air temperature classes with extra-smoothed contour lines
Style.abstract: Same classed palette as temperature_shaded, with a heavier SmoothingFilter of 6 and blue contour lines every 2 degrees overlaid

Layer.Name: air_temperature_hagl_contourtest
Layer.Title: UWCW HA43 (DINI) 5.5km air temperature, for contour testing
Layer.Abstract: High resolution (575x668) air temperature field used to test contour line tracing
